en.name: Roquefort
en.summary: Roquefort is a blue made from raw ewes' milk and ripened in the caves of Combalou — saltier and drier than most blues, which is why it keeps a little longer. Once opened, about 2–3 weeks in the fridge. Freezing is not recommended.
en.pantry: Roquefort is a moist, low-acid cheese and belongs in the fridge. Bring out the piece you are serving about half an hour before eating, which is when the paste opens up, and put the rest back cold. This is the clearest case in the cheese counter of advice that splits by who is eating: for most people it is an ordinary fridge cheese, but it is made from raw milk and it is a blue, and both categories are on the avoid list for pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people — the published advice covers all blue-veined cheeses, pasteurised or not. Cooked through, it is a different matter.
en.fridge: Wrap the cut face in its original foil or in waxed paper — foil is traditional here for a reason, it stops the paste drying and the blue over-breathing — then box it loosely at 0–5 °C. A working limit of 2–3 weeks is our own extrapolation, sitting between the published figure for soft cheeses and the one for opened hard cheese, because Roquefort falls between the two on moisture and salt; no agency publishes a Roquefort number. It goes on ripening in your fridge until it turns bitter and ammoniac, and the salt makes the change hard to taste coming.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended and no timeline is given. Roquefort thaws into wet crumbs and the paste never comes back; the blue also darkens and spreads unevenly. If you have already frozen some, use the crumbs in a dressing or a sauce rather than on a board. Better to buy a small piece more often — Roquefort is sold in small wedges precisely because it does not sit well.
en.thawing: If you have frozen it, thaw it wrapped in the fridge and use it straight into a dressing or a sauce. Do not refreeze it.
spoilage: An ammonia smell that has taken over from the blue.
Fuzzy grey, pink or black growth on the cut face — the blue veining is the cheese, this is not.
A taste that has gone bitter or metallic rather than salty and sharp.
tips: Keep the original foil; it is the best wrapper the cheese will get.
Buy small wedges often rather than one large piece.
Wrap it twice — it will flavour the butter otherwise.
Use up a piece that is turning strong in a sauce or a dressing.

faq.q: How long does Roquefort keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks once opened at 0–5 °C. That figure is our own extrapolation between soft and hard cheese; no agency publishes a Roquefort number.
It is not recommended and no timeline is given. It thaws into wet crumbs that are only useful in a dressing or a sauce.

No. It is both a raw-milk cheese and a blue, and the published advice tells pregnant, elderly and immunocompromised people to avoid all blue-veined cheeses, pasteurised or not. Cooked through, it is acceptable.

faq.q: Why does Roquefort taste of ammonia?
faq.a: It has over-ripened. Ammonia is the end point of a blue cheese, not a stage, and the cheese should go.

zh.name: 洛克福藍紋乳酪
zh.summary: 洛克福是用生綿羊乳製作、在 Combalou 洞穴中熟成的藍紋乳酪，比多數藍紋更鹹更乾，所以可以多撐一點時間。開封後冷藏大約 2～3 週。不建議冷凍。
zh.pantry: 洛克福濕潤、酸度低，應該放冰箱。要吃之前大約半小時把那一塊拿出來，這時質地最開；其餘冰回去。這是整個乳酪櫃裡「建議因人而異」最清楚的一個例子：對多數人來說它只是一支普通的冷藏乳酪，但它同時是生乳製品又是藍紋乳酪，而這兩類都在孕婦、長者與免疫力低下者的迴避清單上——公告建議涵蓋所有藍紋乳酪，不論是否巴氏殺菌。徹底加熱煮透則是另一回事。
zh.fridge: 切面用原本的錫箔紙或蠟紙包好——這裡用錫箔是有道理的，可以避免乳酪體乾掉、也避免藍黴過度呼吸——再放進不密閉的盒子，溫度 0～5 °C。2～3 週這個工作上限是我們自己的推估，落在軟質乳酪與已開封硬質乳酪兩個公告值之間，因為洛克福的含水量與鹽度正好介於兩者之間；沒有任何機構公告過洛克福的數字。它在你的冰箱裡會持續熟成，直到轉為苦味和氨味，而高鹽度讓這個變化不容易提早嚐出來。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍，這裡也不給期限。洛克福解凍後會變成濕碎粒，質地再也回不來，藍黴也會變深、分布不均。如果已經凍了，就把碎粒用在沙拉醬或醬汁裡，不要端上起司盤。比較好的做法是常買小塊——洛克福以小楔形塊零售，正是因為它不耐放。
zh.thawing: 若已冷凍，請連包裝放冷藏解凍，之後直接用在沙拉醬或醬汁。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切面長出灰、粉紅或黑色絨毛霉——藍色紋路是乳酪本身，這些不是。
邊緣出現褐色、半透明並滲液。
吃起來發苦或有金屬味，而不是鹹香明快。
tips: 原本的錫箔紙留著，那是它最好的包裝。
常買小塊，勝過一次買一大塊。
包兩層，不然奶油會整塊變味。
味道開始太衝的那一塊，就做成醬汁或沙拉醬用掉。

faq.q: 洛克福乳酪冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 0～5 °C 下約 2～3 週。這是我們在軟質與硬質乳酪之間的推估；沒有機構公告過洛克福的數字。
不建議，也不給期限。解凍後變成濕碎粒，只適合用在沙拉醬或醬汁。
不建議。它既是生乳乳酪又是藍紋乳酪，而公告建議孕婦、長者與免疫力低下者避開所有藍紋乳酪，不論是否巴氏殺菌。加熱煮透則可以。
代表熟過頭了。氨味是藍紋乳酪的終點而不是階段，這塊該丟了。
